PB05-D01.name: ［Chocolate Operation］Fongneena
PB05-D01.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
You can refresh a "Fongneena" you control. When you've done so, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card from the deckbottom.

PB05-D04.name: ［Chocolate Operation］Noa Fleur
PB05-D04.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

Main - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core])]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add every "Noah-Fleur" among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Every Cost 7 or more "Noah-Fleur" you control gains an extra Yellow symbol.

PB05-D02.name: ［Chocolate Operation］Rei-Ohba
PB05-D02.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
Return every opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom, and for each target returned by this effect, draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card from the deckbottom.

PB05-D03.name: ［Chocolate Operation］Rias Urovorun
PB05-D03.effect:
[teams: Pretty Animals Twilight Gothic]

Main - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core])]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Riolu Tida"/"Rias Urovorun" among them to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to either only the decktop or the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Your "Riolu Tida"/"Rias Urovorun" can't be blocked by opposing Spirits.

P14-42.name: ［Mission School］Fongneena
P14-42.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Fongneena" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, it remains on the Field, refreshed.

PX15-08.name: ［Sengoku Dancing Princess］Fongneena
PX15-08.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Diva" family Spirit attacks, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Diva" family Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to their Trash.
